description: Gets template information for a Sitecore item.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

fields.description: Extra Sitecore field names to include, e.g. ['Title']. Ignored when full is true.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

id.description: The ID of the item to retrieve template information for. Supply this or path.

path.description: The path of the item to retrieve template information for (e.g. /sitecore/content/Home). Supply this or id.

name: common-get-item-template
